title: Fundamental Quandles Do Not Determine the First Postnikov Invariant of 2-Knots
summary: For every admissible pair of Brieskorn parameters in the Plotnick--Suciu construction, we obtain a pair of oriented $2$-knots whose knot groups are isomorphic, whose second homotopy modules are semilinearly isomorphic under a suitable group isomorphism, and whose fundamental quandles are isomorphic, while no compatible group and module isomorphisms carry one first Postnikov invariant to the other.
